name: Regicide
overview: The biblical account of regicide, as illustrated in the story of Ehud and King Eglon, reveals the gravity and solemnity surrounding the removal of a king by force. Ehud's carefully concealed dagger and his secretive approach to Eglon, who was unsuspecting and alone, demonstrate the calculated and serious nature of this act. The narrative emphasizes that such events are not taken lightly but are intertwined with divine purpose, as Ehud declares he has a message from God before executing the king.
